title: Private Nostr Relay
author: Marcus Quinn <marcus@marcusquinn.com>
description: A private, allowlist-write-only Nostr relay powered by strfry.
tagline: Private Nostr relay with allowlisted writes
postInstallMessage: The relay rejects every write until you add an npub or hexadecimal public key to /app/data/allowlist.txt. See the Allowlist guide before connecting a client.
